description: This file provides Vietnamese language translations and tooltips for the CKEditor plugin 'codemirror', specifically for the CodeMirror source plugin within the CKEditor. It defines localized strings for UI elements, shortcuts, and actions related to source code editing functionalities.

methods.name: CKEDITOR.plugins.setLang
methods.description: Sets the language-specific strings for a plugin in CKEditor, here used to load Vietnamese translations for the 'codemirror' plugin.
